brand_identity.name: InfoPilot
brand_identity.voice: Prodigious, Marvelous, Dazzling, Futuristic, Authoritative yet Magical
brand_identity.emotional_tone: A fusion of high-tech precision and deep, mysterious wonder. Think 'Interstellar' meets 'Cyberpunk' but with a romantic, literary soul.
brand_identity.key_visual_metaphor: The Cockpit of a Starship navigating a Nebula of Knowledge

headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, and major labels. Use tight tracking.

layout_strategy.global: Mobile-first responsive. Use 'Bento Grid' layouts for dashboards. Avoid standard vertical scrolling lists where possible; use masonry or grid layouts.
layout_strategy.container_style: Glassmorphism is MANDATORY. Every card should look like a piece of high-tech glass floating in space.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 or Gap-8 for grids.
layout_strategy.navigation: Floating Sidebar (Glass) on Desktop, Bottom Bar (Glass) on Mobile.

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-500 to-purple-600 text-white rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(244,63,94,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(244,63,94,0.7)] transition-all duration-300 font-bold tracking-wide uppercase text-sm py-3 px-8
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 transition-all backdrop-blur-md

cards.base: bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden relative group

inputs.style: bg-slate-950/50 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:border-purple-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500/20 outline-none transition-all

search_bar.style: bg-slate-900/80 border border-purple-500/30 rounded-full px-6 py-4 text-lg shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(139,92,246,0.2)] focus-within:shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(139,92,246,0.4)] focus-within:border-purple-500 transition-all w-full max-w-2xl mx-auto

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture overlay (opacity 0.03) to the entire app to give it a 'film' grain look.
visual_enhancers.glows: Use colored blurs behind major elements (Hero, Active Cards) to create depth.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL TAILWIND: Ensure Tailwind CSS is properly configured. If tailwind.config.js is missing, create it with the config provided above.
2. GLOBAL CSS: Replace the contents of 'App.css' and 'index.css' to remove all legacy white/gray styles. Set the body background to #050510 and text to white.
3. FONTS: Import 'Outfit', 'Manrope', and 'Unbounded' from Google Fonts in index.css.
4. GLASSMORPHISM: Apply the 'glass-panel' style to the Sidebar, Header, and all Cards.
5. BOOK PROMO: Create a dedicated, high-impact section for 'Letters to Evelyn' using the placeholder cover and a 'Glowing Shrine' effect.
6. MAP: For the Map page, use a dark-mode map tile provider (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter) to match the theme.
7. SOCIAL: Redesign the feed to look like a futuristic HUD (Heads Up Display).
8. DATA-TESTID: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use default 'SaaS Blue'. Use the Brand Pink/Purple gradients.
Do not use pure white backgrounds. Use dark slate/indigo with glass effects.
Animations are mandatory for hover states (scale up, glow intensity increase).
Keep the UI 'Dazzling' - err on the side of too much visual interest rather than too little.
